title: Probatio Systemica & Provolution: A Multi-Impact Framework for Climate Transformation
description:
Provolution applies the Probatio Systemica methodology to the problem of global climate transformation. The framework formalizes the SEC-J principle (Sufficient, Efficient, Consistent, Just) with a strict veto condition at J < 0.50 (justice veto, antifragility-grounded after Taleb 2012) and an operational Multi-Impact Assessment Framework v2.0 covering six impact dimensions: GHG accounting, environmental, social and equity, energy and rebound, governance, and systemic pathways.

Probatio Systemica itself is a neutral, mathematically founded framework for systemic verification of complex decisions. It is culture-independent and not climate-specific. Its modular family of seven evaluation modules (PS-U, PV, PD, PI, PN, PP, PT) allows verification of measures, factual claims, political decisions, institutions, media discourse, philosophical arguments, and temporal score drift.

This deposit includes the complete CANON documents (German originals, English translations), the master data files (CO₂ and multi-impact), methodology documentation, application examples (pilots, Kreislauf cases), reproducibility studies, and supporting tools. The framework is designed as a living document — current quantitative results are maintained in the CANON data files; this release captures a specific version snapshot.

License: CC0-1.0 Universal. The Open Hardware License (OHL) applies to the data layer in parallel.
notes: Continuous-development framework. Specific quantitative results (number of levers, CO2 reduction potentials, domain aggregations) are version-dependent and live in canon/data/co2_master.yaml and canon/data/impact_master.yaml within the deposit.
